results.text: Therapeutic Potential of the β3-Adrenergic Receptor and Its Ligands in Cardiovascular Diseases. The β3-adrenergic receptor is an exceptional member of the β-adrenergic receptor family. Recent findings suggest that it may play a more significant role in the cardiovascular system than previously recognized, partly through its potential anti-inflammatory actions.
